# GreenYP

> The Green Industry Business Directory. Connect with landscapers, lawn care pros, nurseries, hardscape suppliers, and other green industry businesses. Tagline: Your Garden. Their Expertise.

GreenYP (also known as GreenPages in mobile and marketing contexts) is a directory and marketplace for the green industry. Homeowners and businesses search for vetted green-industry providers by category and location. Subscribers list their business, manage locations, photos, services, and respond to inquiries. The site also hosts classifieds for green-industry goods and services.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search the directory and browse featured green-industry categories.
- [Categories](/categories): All green-industry business categories.
- [Search](/search): Search providers by keyword, ZIP code, and distance.
- [Classifieds](/classifieds): Browse classified ads for plants, equipment, and services.
- [Classified Categories](/classifieds/categories): Descriptions of all classifieds categories.
- [Post a Classified](/classifieds/create): Create a new classified ad.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with GreenYP.
